column1: # Production member recipes (one line per member family; {S} = seed). Columns: name, seeds, gpu (1 = CUDA), threads, memory (GB), python,
# command, role, arch. Every run trains on the is_rank == 0 rows (all of 2025) of data/features_v9.parquet (+ side tables) and writes
# data/preds/<name>_s{S}.parquet for the is_rank == 1 rows. The 6-fold 2025 OOF of each family (docs/REPRODUCE.md, A1) uses the same command
# with --cv months:a,b. Derived members (step np_derive): queue_decomp_ebdt_s0-2 and sixseed_chain_ebdt6_s0-5 = queue_mkdt.py re-mix of queue_eb_v47lqa p/art and
# arch = the CPU architecture each seed was fitted on in the submitted run. LightGBM and CatBoost CPU fits differ between aarch64 and x86_64;
# a refit elsewhere is a new draw of the same recipe (docs/REPRODUCE.md, determinism).
# The optional members of the v99 line run only with their period flag (WIDELEAF=1: m_wideleaf_a2p; PSEUDOLABEL=1: m_pseudolabel_pl3p88 after the first pass,
# from the period's own pseudo-label file, step xs_pseudo); their python column is bash.
